newsitem.title: USA: Emery, names Eastern US global sales vp.
newsitem.headline: Emery, names Eastern US global sales vp.

text.p: Emery Worldwide has appointed Vincent Gallagher as vice president - Eastern Area global sales, the company said.
Gallagher will be responsible for developing new domestic and international business opportunities and also oversee sales staff in the Eastern U.S, it added in a statement.

Gallagher, to be based in Newark, New Jersey succeeds Gerard Trimarco, recently named to direct the new $1.7-billion U.S. Postal Service contract awarded to Emery and other CNF organizations in May of this year. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
